data.title: Route Overview
paragraphs: Rayalaseema rewards travellers who enjoy heat, stone, distance, and detail. Begin at Lepakshi’s Vijayanagara-era temple complex, continue through the Penna landscape to Gandikota’s dramatic gorge, then connect Belum’s cave system and the sculptural temple traditions of Tadipatri.

The route is intentionally road-based and spacious. Early starts protect the best light and cooler hours, while longer midday pauses keep temple and canyon visits comfortable. Tirupati provides a final sacred counterpoint before departure.
data.imageAlt: Editorial travel portrait representing landscapes and cultural encounters across Andhra Pradesh
data.caption: Bengaluru → Lepakshi → Gandikota → Belum → Tadipatri → Tirupati
highlights: Vijayanagara painting, sculpture, and architecture at Lepakshi.
Sunrise and evening light over Gandikota’s Penna gorge.
A guided visit through the limestone formations of Belum Caves.
Temple sculpture and sacred architecture across Tadipatri and Tirupati.

introParagraphs: This 9-day journey is paced around meaningful stays, sensible road movement, and enough time in each landscape to understand it rather than simply pass through.

items: Characterful hotels and heritage-style stays chosen for comfort in a road-intensive region.
Private air-conditioned vehicle with early departures on exposed sightseeing days.

data.title: Suggested Packing & Preparation
items: Light breathable clothing for warm, dry daytime conditions.
A hat, sunscreen, and refillable bottle for exposed fort and canyon walks.
Comfortable shoes with grip for stone steps and cave surfaces.
Modest temple clothing that covers shoulders and knees.
A light scarf for dust and strong afternoon sun.

data.title: HEAT & WALKING NOTE
data.text: October to February is generally the most comfortable window. Exposed stone sites can become very hot later in the day, so major walks are scheduled early with generous midday breaks.

data.title: A Journey Written in Stone
paragraphs: The power of Rayalaseema lies in scale: giant boulders, deep gorges, painted temple ceilings, carved pillars, and long horizons between settlements.
By slowing the road down, the region stops feeling sparse and begins to read as a connected landscape of geology, devotion, and dynastic memory.

items.question: Can this route be tailored to our preferred dates and pace?
paragraphs: Yes. Every Signature itinerary is a design framework, and we adjust nights, experiences, transport, and daily intensity around your interests and travel dates.

items.question: Is this itinerary physically demanding?
paragraphs: It includes uneven stone, cave surfaces, and exposed walks, but daily distances can be shortened and adapted.

items.question: Why begin from Bengaluru?
paragraphs: Lepakshi is naturally approached from Bengaluru, creating a cleaner road flow into southern Andhra Pradesh.

items.question: Can Tirupati be omitted?
paragraphs: Yes. The final days can instead focus on additional Rayalaseema heritage or a relaxed departure routing.

items.question: What is included when the final journey is quoted?
paragraphs: The final proposal clearly separates accommodation, private transport, guiding, arranged experiences, and any route-specific permits or specialist access.
items.listTitle: The exact inclusion list is confirmed before payment:

Any permits or special-access costs included in the final design.

items.question: How are reservations confirmed and scheduled?
paragraphs: Once the bespoke route, accommodation selection, and current supplier availability are approved, a 30% confirmation deposit secures the agreed services. The remaining balance is due 45 days before arrival unless the final proposal states otherwise.

items.question: What is the policy for date changes or cancellations?
paragraphs: We work directly with our partners to move dates whenever possible. Any non-refundable permits, transport tickets, or supplier penalties are passed through transparently.
listItems: 60+ days before arrival: deposit refund less confirmed non-refundable costs.
30–59 days before arrival: 50% refund or travel credit where supplier terms allow.
Less than 30 days before arrival: cancellation follows the confirmed supplier terms in your final proposal.
